title: Strict C++-to-Rust Program Port — Full
summary: Comprehensive, opt-in profile idea for a high-fidelity, maintainable C++-to-Rust replacement. Start from the language-neutral core of C-to-Rust Full (PROFILE-0002), with complete behavior/feature inventory, differential and edge-case test matrices, build/CI, coverage, reproducible validation, documentation, versioning, release/MVP gates, roadmaps and evidence-based progress. Add separately reviewed C++-specific requirements for RAII/destructor and exception semantics, object models and dispatch/templates, ABI/FFI and data layout, concurrency/atomicity, platform/toolchain differences, and explicit deviations. Lite must be a strict subset of Full; no existing C-to-Rust selection is automatically copied or approved.
